**Verdict: Needs changes before merge - not built, read-only review. The code of this PR is clean; the PR must wait for its parent PR #3059.**

## What looks good

- Requested item 2 is done: `crates/motion/tests/chamfer_open_refusals.rs:3` now has `//! Gate map: covers camcraft_motion::machining2d (chamfer, open-run refusals).` The only change since the reviewed head 75d54dcf2 is those two header lines, so the rest of that review's checks stand.
- The refusal law checks still hold at this head: the guard at `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs:233` refuses with `GenError::Empty` and cannot panic; the collapse case gives its own named message. No silent pass path.
- File sizes are under the limit (chamfer.rs 274 lines, chamfer_circular.rs 350, chamfer_open_refusals.rs 98). No goldens, no new dependencies, no process files, no `build.rs` / `.github` / scripts changes.
- The body ends `Fixes #3086` and `Changelog: none` is correct: the feature is unreleased; its row belongs to #3059.

## Results

Not built: read-only review (fork PR; neither this review nor the runner builds it). Your comment reports the targeted gate green: 3 `chamfer_open_refusals`, 10 `chamfer_circular`, 5 `chamfer_open_edges` tests, plus clippy.

Heavy lanes: the head's own diff (one error message, a test move, two comment lines) reaches no heavy lane. The parent's feat commits are covered by #3059's review, not here.

## About your point 2 in the reply comment

You are right, and my earlier instruction does not work as written: #3059's head branch `issue/2988-chamfer-open-edge-chains` lives in paulrobin/Camcraft, and GitHub cannot point a PR from your fork at a branch in another fork. My apologies for that.

The state is still not ready, for the same root cause: this head carries #3059's unmerged commits `4e22c8dbe` and `2fbe6f2fb`, and `gh pr diff 3115` still shows all 9 files, including `crates/app/src/operation/*`. Merging it now would land a `feat` (P6) in `main` ahead of the cut. #3059 is still open, a draft, and labelled `conflicts`.

## Requested before merge

1. Wait for #3059 to merge into `main`. Your branch already holds its commits, so afterwards the diff against `main` shrinks automatically to your fix - no push is needed for that. Then merge `origin/main` into your branch and ask for a re-check. (AGENTS.md "Overlapping issues stack": the parent merges first.)
2. Optional meanwhile: mark this PR draft (or leave it open as it is) so it is not mistaken for merge-ready. A maintainer will not merge it before #3059.

Nothing in the code itself needs a change. Once #3059 is in `main`, a re-check at the refreshed head should make this PR merge-ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
